note: FEATURE CHECKLIST / ROADMAP - drives admin/roadmap/. Statuses: done (shipped and live), part (placeholder or partial - the shape exists, the engine does not), plan (not started - designed or listed only). Edit this file to update the checklist; the page renders it as-is. 'detail' is the honest one-line truth of where it stands.

high.t: Core content: Arabic / Quran / Islamic Studies sections
high.d: All three subject tabs live with interactive lessons, references, and trackers.

high.t: Practice tab: unified deck + glossary pipeline
high.d: One build script discovers every word source (1,057 terms, 78 lists); deck and glossary read from it.
Passphrase curtain + Staff/Student view-as. Superficial by design - real auth is the sign-on feature below.

high.t: Quran reader: highlights, flags, ranges, book view, share links
high.d: Six highlighter colors, flag-to-revisit, start-stop reading range, book flow - all travel on assignment links for remote guidance.
Student view live with on-device activity + sample academics; admin gradebook on the real roster with sample metrics. Real grades need accounts.

high.t: Audio: listen to recitation per ayah
high.d: Stream a qari per ayah in the reader. Needs an audio CDN decision (everyayah-style) and offline fallback.

high.t: Audio: record + sound library in the student profile
high.d: MediaRecorder capture on the Recording Checklist, saved to the student's library and surfaced to the teacher in the gradebook. Storage needs the Phase F backend.
Today: teacher sends a link carrying range + highlights + flags. Next: a shared session where the teacher's position moves the student's view (needs a realtime channel).
Student/teacher/admin login replacing the staff curtain. Phase F: identity provider + roster sync.

Rule-driven visibility: free sees X, premium sees X+Y, admin sees all; per-level scoping (e.g. a Level 1 Quran student hides Islamic Studies). nav.json already gates per-section (adminOnly) - generalize to a profiles map.
Depends on access profiles + payments. Decide what is ever paywalled for a volunteer school before building.
A student enrolled only in Arabic sees an Arabic-first portal. Same profiles map, keyed by enrollment.
Push assignment links (the reader already generates them) as Classroom assignments; pull rosters. Needs OAuth + the accounts layer first.
Giving pages are live as present-and-route (official channels, no on-site processing - deliberate). True integration = a processor + webhooks + the ledger.
Footer social strip is live. Dedicated landing/share pages with OpenGraph cards per section: not started.
Schema, migration sequence, embedding pipeline and export step are designed in the Feature Backlog doc. Postgres + object storage behind an API; the JSON contracts become seed fixtures.
Rides on Phase F: assignments, submissions, grades tables; the Grades page becomes live data.

low.d: On push: run the jsdom harness + Playwright suite + contrast audit, rebuild glossary, then deploy Pages. Replaces trust-me deploys.
Mirror of the Actions pipeline for practice parity with work tooling. Build after Actions is proven.
Numbered feature branches merged to master with tags matching admin/version.json (v25, v26...). Replaces direct-to-master.

build_glossary.py fails loudly on shape surprises; 55-check jsdom harness + 39-check browser suite exist. Not started: one site-wide validate.py (nav.json refs resolve, JSON contracts well-formed, links unbroken) runnable locally and in CI.

low.t: Map files: titles → emoji → hand-drawn image
low.d: nav.json maps every page to emoji + icons.svg hand-drawn id, switchable site-wide. Not started: extending the map to lesson images / the image library.
Placeholder card in the Admin Panel; images live in assets/ and scans/. Browsable library with upload needs Phase F storage.
Custom domain + HTTPS live on portal.albaseeraacademy.com. Not started: apex strategy, SPF/DKIM/DMARC for school mail, search-console verification, security.txt.
GitHub Pages fronting absorbs volumetric attacks and the site is static (no injectable backend). Revisit when Phase F adds an API: WAF/rate limits, input validation server-side, audit logging.
The moment uploads/recordings exist: type checks, size caps, AV scanning, moderation queue.
Page-level usage without tracking children personally. Candidate: self-hosted counts per page, no cookies.
Installable with cached lessons for weekend classrooms with poor Wi-Fi. Service worker + manifest.
On-device daily counter (ab-time) feeding the Grades page. Server-side rollup arrives with accounts.
